contract: Checkout (/checkout) mobile layout optimization (Paket Lengkap A): full-width payment option text + stacked bank badges, reduced nested padding on Step 1/Map/Summary card, full-width Gunakan Lokasi Saya & Cek Ongkir buttons, 2-line order item product names, and 100% unchanged Desktop (> 768px) layout.

accessibility.evidence: All form inputs, radio options, Gunakan Lokasi Saya button (286x36px), Cek Ongkir button (313x33px), and Buat Pesanan Sekarang CTA have clear labels and comfortable touch targets on 375x812.

responsive.evidence: Mobile 375x812: pageOverflow=0px, Transfer Bank payment card height reduced from 154px to 93px (titleWidth increased from 107px to 258px), Map width increased from 263px to 285px, map label height reduced from 60px (3 lines) to 20px (1 line). Desktop 1440x900: 100% identical to baseline (container=1200x1940px, step1Card=621x1146px, mapEl=531x220px, summaryCard=517x632px, paymentTransfer=467x80px).

loading.evidence: #btnRefreshShipping shows spinner and 'Memuat...' while fetching Biteship courier rates.

empty.evidence: Empty cart redirects to /cart with 'Keranjang belanja kosong' fallback.

error.evidence: Form validation automatically expands the address accordion and reports invalid fields; failed API shows SweetAlert error.

partial.evidence: Saved addresses with or without GPS coordinates and products with or without custom cake text render cleanly.

success.evidence: Submitting checkout clears local cart and redirects to order success page.

permission.evidence: Unauthenticated visitors to /checkout are redirected to /login via auth middleware.

renderedEvidence.observation: Clean mobile checkout layout at 375x812 with wider 285px map, 1-line map label + full-width Gunakan Lokasi Saya button, full-width Cek Ongkir button, 1-column courier cards, 2-line wrapped product names, and unclutterd 93px Transfer Bank payment option.
Desktop 2-column checkout layout at 1440x900 preserved 100% unchanged.
